note: Ritchey Creek Campground, the park's one campground, in redwood and fir forest off Hwy 128/29 between Calistoga and St Helena. The park is run for State Parks by the Napa County Regional Park and Open Space District. Sites 1-12 line the park road on the bank of Ritchey Creek; the rest ring a loop at the canyon's west end. Wood fires are banned at times. --Claude
summary: Bothe-Napa Valley: $43 confirmed (every night checked, Jan-May 2027), no hookups, 50 sites (12 tent-only), trailers 24 ft / motorhomes 31 ft, year-round, max stay 14; creekside kept on sites along the creek road (4, 5, 7, 10, 11 on the creek side), with a canopy caveat; pin fine; operated by Napa County's open-space district.
flags: WATERFRONT (creekside kept, with a caveat): the park map puts sites 1-12 along the park road on the north bank of Ritchey Creek (perennial, NHD FCode 46006, a few metres wide - creek, not river). Sites 4, 5, 7, 10 and 11 (all RV 'Campsite' units a 23-ft rig can book; 1-3 are tent-only) are drawn on the creek side of the road. 3DEP transects from the road reach the channel 27-33 m south over a 13-21% bank (124.1 -> 118.3 m; 129.7 -> 125.5 m), so the creek-side pads are ~10-25 m from the water with an easy walk down. Everything is under continuous canopy: imagery cannot confirm or veto. The west loop (13-50) is 45-105 m from the creek behind the park road and is not on the water. ReserveCalifornia tags only tent site 1 'Creek nearby'.
